gates.description: Full local release gate for the exact source revision
Actual local TLS, installed UI and agent network boundary
Offline scan of built runtime/dashboard and pinned PostgreSQL/OPA images
Named disposable repository, selected-repository GitHub App and real approved/denied workflow evidence
Independent clean Linux host installation, certificate validation, backup restore and isolation proof
Independent human review of this revision, threat boundaries and acceptance evidence; critical/high findings resolved
Named host/account, DNS/TLS, private access path and explicit deployment/budget approval
Named incident/patch owner, external encrypted backup destination and tested restore/revocation procedure

limitation: External gates require actual separately reviewed evidence. This command has no flag to relabel an offline fixture as live or approve deployment.
